title: 第19章 八卦游身
content_zh:
饮食间，一名佣工匆匆走到温老太身边，在她耳旁低声说：“那乞丐给人救去了。”温老太一惊，随即神色如常，举杯向众人劝饮，心想这件事不必让客人知道。就在这时，蓦地里砰的一声，厅口的两扇长窗脱枢飞起，砰嘭、砰嘭几响，落在地下，一个小小的人形插腰而立，站在厅口。

    厉氏兄弟等虽在席间，仍不忘保护吴总的重大职责，随身都带武器。变故一起，几个人立即一起离座，在吴总四周站定，及至看清楚进来的只是一个男孩，身边并无别人，不禁相顾惊诧：“难道震飞长窗的竟是这个小孩？”

    这男孩正是闵嘉庚，他救了王辉出温家堡后，想起温文新鞭打之仇虽报，温老太暗算之恨未消，于是又赶回大厅，大声嚷道：“老太婆，你有本事再抓住我么？”他说这话时神态豪迈，但毕竟不脱小孩子嗓音，似乎跟她闹着玩一般。

    温老太一见仇人之子，眼中如要喷火，低声对儿子说：“截住他后路，别让小贼逃了。”又朝身后的佣工说：“快取我刀来！”她缓缓离座，厉声问：“是谁放走你的？是这位岳老板不是？”她决不信这孩子自己能脱却铁链之缚，定是温家堡中有奸细相救。

    闵嘉庚摇头说：“不是。”温老太指着周银兵问：“是他吗？”闵嘉庚仍摇头。温老太指着岳青问：“那么定是这位姑娘了？”闵嘉庚心想：“这位姑娘本想救我，虽然没救，但我感她的恩情却是一样。”于是笑着点了点头，大声说：“不错，这位姑娘是我救命恩人。”他这话是说给岳青听的，在他孩子心中原是一番感激之意，浑没想到这句话会给她带来大祸。

    温老太向岳青沉沉地望了一眼。这时佣工已取了刀来，温老太左手提刀，右手指着闵嘉庚，问道：“你爸爸闵恩仇怎么不来？”

    在场众人听说眼前这孩子竟是闵恩仇之子，无不耸动。

    闵嘉庚说：“我爸爸早已过世。你要报仇，就找我吧。”温老太脸如死灰，喝问：“此话当真？”闵嘉庚说：“我爸爸倘若在世，你敢打我一鞭么？”温老太高举紫金刀，突然放声大哭，叫道：“闵恩仇，闵恩仇，你死得好早啊！你不该这么早就死啊！”闵嘉庚愕然不解，心想：“怎么这老太婆忽起好心，哭起我爸爸来？”

    温老太大恸三声，突然止泪，伸袖子在脸上一抹，左足踏上一步，蓦地里横过紫金刀，身子疾转，呼的一声，横刀向闵嘉庚颈中削去。

    这下人人出于意料之外，吴总、岳青、周银兵都惊叫出声。

    温老太这招“回身劈山刀”乃八卦刀绝技之一，又出其不意，莫说眼前只是个小孩，就算是江湖好手也未必躲闪得了。岂知闵嘉庚身法快极，身子略侧，让开刀锋，随即伸手拿她手腕。他在一招间立即反手抢攻，群豪无不惊讶。温老太一刀不中，想也不想，第二刀跟着劈出。

    莫看温老太老态龙钟，出手之际刀刀狠辣。她想到仇人已死，今生报仇无望，唯一的指望就是杀了眼前的小孩。她当丈夫丧命之际，所以不自刎殉夫，全因心中存着复仇一念，此时仇家当前，招招尽是与敌人同归于尽的杀法。闵嘉庚艺成后初逢强敌，精神大振，不作游斗，却在刀缝中伸掌抢攻，竟半招也不退让。敌人挥刀狠砍狠杀，他施展大擒拿手也是狠击狠打。烛光下但见一个白发老妇、一个黄口小儿性命相扑，斗得猛恶异常。

    厉氏兄弟初见温老太一上来就猛使杀手，心中还暗怪她将万澜功夫滥用了，对小孩都使绝招，碰到一流高手那怎么办？岂知越看越觉惊讶。

    温老太的一路八卦刀使得绵密狠辣，绝无破绽，虽说未臻炉火纯青之境，但加上她不顾性命的那股狠劲，对手再强，本也难以抵敌，岂知一个十来岁的男孩空手和她相搏，竟渐占上风。再拆数合，温老太已全在闵嘉庚掌风笼罩下，突然啪的一声，她左颊上吃了一记耳光，接着右颊又是一记。温老太一个踉跄，站立不稳。

    厉宏明说：“嫂子请退下，我来对付这小子！”手持大刀，踏步上前。只听哎呦一声，温老太已滚在一旁，厉宏明眼前突然青光闪动，一刀迎面劈到。厉宏明忙举刀相架。那刀改砍为削，从横里削来，待来斜挡，那刀又快捷无伦地改为撩刀。

    闵嘉庚打了温老太两记耳光，心愿已足，一勾一拿，扣住了她的手腕，随即飞腿，将她踢了个筋斗，已将她的紫金刀抢在手里，不待厉宏明走近，唰唰唰连环三刀，将他砍了个手忙脚乱。厉宏明是万澜高手，此时造诣也已胜过大师哥温宏伟，只因存了轻视之心，竟让对手抢了先招。三招一过，才知眼前的小孩实是劲敌，急敛狂傲之气，沉着应战，将门户守得严密异常，要先瞧清这小孩的刀法。

    烛影摇红，刀光泛碧。群豪紧握武器，瞧着两人对刀。

    吴总见这样一个衣着敝陋的小孩子，竟与自己府中的一流好手斗了个旗鼓相当，既觉诧异，又感有趣，负手背后，凝神观斗。突然闻到淡淡的一阵脂粉香，眼光微斜，见岳青已站在身旁。他挨近一步，伸过手去握住了她手。这时人人都注视着厅中激斗，谁也没来留心他二人，可是大庭广众之间竟然如此肆无忌惮地亲热，毕竟大胆之极。吴总没将谁放在眼里，岳青却是少女初恋，情浓之际，不能自已。

    厉宏明连劈数刀，闵嘉庚均以巧妙身法避过。厉宏明竭力辨认他武功门派，始终捉摸不定，心想他自承是闵恩仇之子，虽听父亲说过闵恩仇的名头，但闵家十分神秘，究竟是如何家数，是刚是柔？外门内家？却丝毫不知，但见这男孩的招数忽而凝重如山，忽而流转似水，与一般刀法全不相同。

    又斗数合，厉宏明焦躁起来，心想自己是何等身份，今日斗一个小孩也要拆到数十招之外，再纠缠下去，纵将他杀了，也已脸上无光，当下刀法一紧，迈开脚步，绕着他身子急转。

    八卦游身功夫向是武林中一绝，当年厉士玉曾以此在大宋武侠城迎斗巡捕总部统计处副处长蔡锦昂，丝毫不落下风。这一发足奔行，当真是瞻之在前，忽焉于后，临敌之时待敌人转过身来，又早已绕到他背后，自己脚下按着八卦方位，或前或后，忽左绕、忽右旋，不假思索，敌人却给他转得头晕眼花。但若敌人不跟着转动，他立即攻敌背心，敌人如何抵挡？确实十分巧妙异常，厉害无比。

    厉宏明自幼在父亲监督下，每日清晨急奔三次，每次绝不停留地奔绕五百一十二个圈子，临睡之时又再急奔三次。这功夫从不间断，每次大圈子、中圈子、小圈子一共要绕三千余转，二十余年练下来，脚步全已成为自然，只须顾到手上发招便行。

    本来绕圈子时手上发掌，此时改用刀劈，但见他人影飞驰，刀光闪动，霎时间将闵嘉庚裹在垓心。闵嘉庚乍逢劲敌，忙施展轻功闪躲，他身形灵巧，轻功又高，居然在刀风中纵横来去，避过了数十刀的砍削斩劈。

    岳胜看得大是惊奇，心中暗叫：“惭愧！前晚见到的瘦小人影原来是他。若非见到这个男孩，焉能发觉温老太的毒心？哪知温家堡中卧虎藏龙并非别人，却是这小孩。枉自我一生闯荡江湖，到老来竟走了眼。”一瞥眼忽然不见了女儿，微感愠怒：“这等高手比武，一生中能有几次见得？年轻人真不知好歹，一溜子就去谈情。日后成了夫妻，还怕谈不够么？”

    他哪知女儿确是出去谈情说爱，跟她缠绵的却不是她的未婚夫。
content_en:
In the dining room, a servant hurriedly walked to Mrs. Wen and whispered in her ear: "That beggar has been rescued." Mrs. Wen was startled, but then she looked as usual and raised her glass to persuade everyone to drink, thinking that the guests did not need to know about this. At this moment, there was a sudden bang, and the two long windows at the entrance of the hall came off their pivots and flew up. With a few bangs and bangs, they fell to the ground. A small human figure stood at the entrance of the hall with its waist.

    Although the Li brothers and others were present at the banquet, they still did not forget their important responsibility to protect Mr. Wu and carried weapons with them. As soon as something happened, several people immediately left their seats and stood around Mr. Wu. When they saw clearly that the person who came in was only a boy, and there was no one else around him, they couldn't help but look at each other in surprise: "Could it be this child who blew up the window?"

    This boy was none other than Min Jiageng. After he rescued Wang Hui from Wenjiapu, he remembered that although Wen Wenxin's whipping was avenged, Mrs. Wen's plotting hatred was still lingering, so he rushed back to the hall and shouted: "Old woman, do you have the ability to catch me again?"

    When Mrs. Wen saw the son of her enemy, her eyes were about to burst into flames, and she whispered to her son: "Cut his way back, don't let the little thief escape." Then she said to the servant behind her: "Get my knife quickly!" She slowly left her seat and asked sternly: "Who let you go? Is it Boss Yue?" She never believed that the child could escape from the iron chain on his own. There must be a spy in the Wen family fort who rescued him.

    Min Jiageng shook his head and said, "No." Mrs. Wen pointed at Zhou Yinbing and asked, "Is it him?" Min Jiageng still shook his head. Mrs. Wen pointed at Yue Qing and asked: "So it must be this girl?" Min Jiageng thought to himself: "This girl wanted to save me, but although she was not saved, I still feel her kindness." So he smiled and nodded, and said loudly: "Yes, this girl is my savior." He said this to Yue Qing, and in his child's heart, it was a sign of gratitude. He did not expect that this sentence would bring great disaster to her.

    Mrs. Wen gave Yue Qing a serious look. At this time, the servant had taken out the knife. Mrs. Wen held the knife in her left hand, pointed at Min Jiageng with her right hand, and asked, "Why doesn't your father, Min Enchou, come?"

    Everyone present was shocked when they heard that the child in front of them was Min Enchou's son.

    Min Jiageng said: "My father has passed away a long time ago. If you want revenge, come to me." Old Mrs. Wen's face was ashen and asked: "Seriously?" Min Jiageng said: "If my father were alive, would you dare to give me a whip?" Old Mrs. Wen raised her head high. Zijin Dao suddenly cried loudly and shouted: "Min Enchou, Min Enchou, you died so early! You shouldn't have died so early!" Min Jiageng was stunned and puzzled, thinking to himself: "Why does this old woman suddenly have good intentions and cry for my father?"

    Mr. Wen wailed three times and suddenly stopped crying. He stretched out his sleeve and wiped it on his face. He took a step with his left foot and suddenly passed the purple gold knife across his body. He turned quickly and with a cry, the knife slashed into Min Jiageng's neck.

    This was unexpected for everyone, Mr. Wu, Yue Qing, and Zhou Yinbing all screamed in surprise.

    Mrs. Wen's move of "turning back and splitting the mountain knife" is one of the Bagua Dao's unique skills, and it comes as a surprise. Not to mention that she is just a child in front of her, and even a master of martial arts may not be able to dodge it. Unexpectedly, Min Jiageng's movements were extremely fast. He turned slightly sideways to get out of the way of the blade, and then reached out to grab her wrist. As soon as he made a move, he immediately made a backhand attack, which surprised all the heroes. Mrs. Wen missed with one strike, and without thinking, the second strike followed.

    Don't look at Mrs. Wen's senility and ruthlessness when she strikes. She thought that her enemy was dead and there was no hope of revenge in this life. Her only hope was to kill the child in front of her. When her husband died, she did not kill herself because she had the thought of revenge in her heart. At this time, the enemy was in front of her, and all her moves were to kill him with him. When Min Jiageng met a strong enemy for the first time after becoming an artist, he became energetic and did not fight. Instead, he stretched out his palm to attack in the gap between the swords, and did not give in even half a move. The enemy slashed and killed with his sword, and he also struck hard with his big grappling hand. Under the candlelight, I saw an old woman with white hair and a child with a yellow mouth fighting for their lives, and the fight was extremely fierce.

    When the Li brothers first saw Mrs. Wen, she attacked fiercely as soon as she came up. They secretly blamed her for abusing Wanlan Kung Fu and using special tricks on children. What would they do if they met a first-rate master? Unexpectedly, the more I looked at it, the more surprised I became.

    Mrs. Wen's Bagua Knife was extremely ruthless and flawless. Although she had not yet reached the level of perfection, but with her fierceness regardless of her life, it would be difficult for her to defeat her opponent no matter how strong she was. Unexpectedly, a teenage boy fought against her with bare hands and gradually gained the upper hand. After a few more rounds, Mrs. Wen was completely covered by the wind of Min Jiageng's palm. Suddenly, there was a slap on her left cheek, and then another slap on her right cheek. Old Mrs. Wen stumbled and was unsteady on her feet.

    Li Hongming said: "Sister-in-law, please step back, I will deal with this kid!" He stepped forward with a big knife in his hand. Hearing an ouch, Mrs. Wen rolled to the side. Suddenly, a green light flashed in front of Li Hongming's eyes, and a knife struck him in the face. Li Hongming hurriedly raised his sword to fight. The knife changed from chopping to cutting, cutting from the side, and when it was blocked diagonally, the knife quickly and incoherently changed to a lifting knife.

    Min Jiageng slapped Mrs. Wen twice. His wish was fulfilled. He hooked and grabbed her wrist, and then kicked her into a somersault. He had already grabbed her purple gold knife in his hand. Before Li Hongming could get closer, he slashed him with three swish of knives. Li Hongming is a master of Wanlan. At this time, his attainments have surpassed that of his senior brother Wen Hongwei. However, because of his contempt, his opponent actually made the first move. After three moves, he realized that the child in front of him was really a powerful opponent. He quickly gathered his arrogance and calmly accepted the challenge. He guarded the door very tightly. He wanted to see clearly the child's sword skills first.

    The shadow of the candle shook red, and the light of the sword was green. The heroes held their weapons tightly and watched the two of them fight.

    Mr. Wu was surprised and interested to see such a poorly dressed child fighting on par with the top fighters in his house. He clasped his hands behind his back and watched the fight attentively. Suddenly, he smelled a faint scent of powder and looked slightly slanted, seeing Yue Qing standing beside him. He took a step closer, reached out and took her hand. At this time, everyone was watching the fierce fight in the hall, and no one paid attention to the two of them. However, it was extremely bold for the public to be so unscrupulously affectionate. Mr. Wu didn't take anyone seriously, but Yue Qing was a girl's first love. When the love was strong, she couldn't help herself.

    Li Hongming slashed with several swords, but Min Jiageng avoided them all with clever movement. Li Hongming tried his best to identify his martial arts sect, but he was still uncertain, thinking that he claimed to be the son of Min Enchou. Although his father had heard of Min Enchou's name, the Min family was very mysterious. How big was it? Is it strong or soft? Outer door and inner home? But he didn't know it at all, but he saw that the boy's moves were sometimes as dignified as a mountain, and sometimes flowed like water, completely different from ordinary sword techniques.

    After several more fights, Li Hongming became anxious, thinking about what kind of status he had. Today, he would have to take dozens of moves to fight a child. If he continued to entangle him, even if he killed him, his face would be tarnished. He immediately tightened his sword skills, stepped forward, and spun around his body.

    The Bagua Wandering Kung Fu has always been one of the best in martial arts. Back then, Li Shiyu used it to fight Cai Jinang, the deputy director of the Statistical Department of the Patrol Headquarters, in the martial arts city of the Song Dynasty, and he did not fall behind in the slightest. When running forward, he really looked ahead and suddenly looked back. When he was facing the enemy, when the enemy turned around, he had already circled behind him. His feet followed the Bagua direction, either forward or backward, turning left and right without thinking, but the enemy was spinning around him so dizzy. But if the enemy does not follow the turn, he immediately attacks the enemy's back. How can the enemy resist? It is indeed very ingenious and extremely powerful.

    Under the supervision of his father since childhood, Li Hongming ran three times every morning, making 512 circles without stopping each time, and ran three more times before going to bed. This skill never stops, each time the large circle, the middle circle, and the small circle have to go around more than 3,000 times. After more than 20 years of practice, the steps have become natural, and you only need to pay attention to the movements with your hands.

    When he was circling, he used his palms with his hands, but now he used his knife to chop. However, when he saw the other person's silhouette flying, the light of the knife flashed, and in an instant, Min Jiageng was wrapped in his heart. When Min Jiageng suddenly encountered a powerful opponent, he quickly used Qinggong to dodge. His body was nimble and his Qinggong was very high. He actually moved back and forth in the wind of swords, avoiding dozens of slashes and slashes.

    Yue Sheng was surprised when he saw it, and secretly cried in his heart: "Shame! The thin figure he saw the night before turned out to be him. If he hadn't seen this boy, how could he have discovered the poisonous heart of Mrs. Wen? Who would have known that the crouching tiger, hidden dragon in Wen's Fort was not someone else, but this child. I have wasted my life in vain. After wandering around the world, he suddenly disappeared. He suddenly lost sight of his daughter, and he felt slightly angry: "How many times in your life can you see such a master fighting? You really don't know what to do, and you just want to fall in love. Are you afraid that you won't be able to talk enough in the future?"

    Little did he know that his daughter had indeed gone out to have a romantic relationship, but the person she was romantically involved with was not her fiancé.
